A second person is partly visible reclining on the bed about 2–3 m ahead and roughly 1.5–2 m behind the red-haired person, with bedding partially occluding their body. The foreground person, nearby seat or bedding, and the camera wearer’s hands are within the wearer’s arm’s reach, while the reclining person and rear-wall objects are not; the foreground person is also much closer to the desk on the left than to the right-side shelf. From frames 1–5 the viewpoint shifts and turns slightly right, the red-haired person moves from lower-left toward lower-center/right while remaining close, and the wearer’s arm enters from the left in frames 3–4 and the lower-right in frame 5, partly occluding the foreground.
